sqlMap.select: SELECT BUYER AS BUYER , QUOTATION_NO AS IF_NO , CATEGORY_PATH AS CATEGORY_NO , DESCRIPTION AS DESCRIPTION_LOC , SPECIFICATION AS SPECIFICATION_ENG , DATA02 AS DESCRIPTION_ENG , MAKER_NAME AS MAKER_NAME , DATA01 AS DATA01 , DATA03 AS ADD_USER_ID , UNIT_MEASURE AS UNIT_MEASURE FROM EAI.IF_UCUBE_IT_SEND WHERE BUYER IN (SELECT BUYER FROM IF_ADMIN WHERE BUYER_ID = 'DWHA') AND IF_FLAG = 'N'
sqlMap.update: UPDATE EAI.IF_UCUBE_IT_SEND SET IF_FLAG = #IF_FLAG# , IF_DATE = SYSDATE , IF_MSG = #IF_MSG# WHERE BUYER IN (SELECT BUYER FROM IF_ADMIN WHERE BUYER_ID = 'DWHA') AND QUOTATION_NO = #QUOTATION_NO#
